legal_basis.from: Planning Commission recommendation reported 2026-04-16; county board action not confirmed
legal_basis.to: Otoe County Board of Commissioners motion (made by Commissioner Cole, seconded by Commissioner Crownover), adopted by unanimous voice vote (4-0; Commissioner Freshman absent) at the May 19, 2026 regular meeting, following a public hearing and the Planning Commission's April 16, 2026 recommendation. The same meeting also created a zoning review committee (Commissioners Jerad Sornson and Chuck Cole, Dan Thomson, and Jenniffer Panko-Rahe, plus Planning Board representatives Dan Hodges, Howard Bebout, and Cheri Wirthele) to update the county's zoning regulations. No separately numbered ordinance or resolution was adopted for the moratorium itself (compare Resolution 5-19-26-4 and Resolution 5-19-26-5, both adopted at the same meeting for unrelated matters).

evidence.supports: Adoption date, 4-0 vote, one-year duration with early-termination condition, creation of zoning review committee, and absence of a named applicant in the hearing
evidence.quote: Cole made a motion, seconded by Crownover, to enter a moratorium on building and conditional use permits regarding data centers for up to one year. The zoning review committee will update the zoning regulations to establish regulations, and the moratorium may be lifted earlier if regulations are updated and approved. Voting aye were Cole, Sornson, Parsons, and Crownover. Nay - none. Motion carried.

decisions.notes: The certified minutes are unambiguous and dispositive: this row moves from 'pending' to 'active,' with an exact adoption date and duration. No separate ordinance/resolution number covers the moratorium itself; it was adopted by board motion, distinct from the two numbered resolutions (5-19-26-4, 5-19-26-5) passed the same day for other business. As of 2026-07-31, the up-to-one-year moratorium (running to on or about 2027-05-19) remains in effect; no report of the zoning review committee's regulations being finalized or the moratorium being lifted early was found in this pass.
